title: Old Man Mountain Updates the Axle Pack With V2: Now 20% Lighter
content:
Old Man Mountain’s Axle Pack was launched in 2024 to transform any fork into an adventure-worthy one, with sturdy 3-Pack mounts. Now Old Man Mountain is releasing the Axle Pack v2. Coming in at a minuscule 59g per side, Axle Pack v2 is 20% lighter than its predecessor….

Most bike mounts are rated to just 1.5kg each. Add to that low weight limit the possibility of an impact to the bags on a tree or rock, and you have a fair chance of ripping the eyelets out of your fork, especially a carbon fork. Axle Pack v2 is rated to 10kg per pair and, because it is axle-mounted, protects your fork from potential damage.

Axle Pack is a lifesaver on suspension forks when clamping can compress seals. Axle mounting is also ideal on carbon forks that taper and cause clamps to slip. Fork-mounted gear helps balance the weight on your bike and keeps your bike’s center of gravity low and stable.

OMM Axle Pack V2 Quick Hits

  • Fits any fork using OMM’s thru axle Fit Kits.
  • Made from 6061 aluminum, Axle Pack is lightweight, stiff, and strong.
  • A svelte 59g per side.
  • It securely mounts to our axle studs.
  • Cannot slide down or rotate around the fork legs.
  • It can carry a lot more than a fork that has 3-pack mounts.
  • Made in Taiwan.
  • Lifetime warranty!

Get yours today at OMM
